statement: Whenever the function returns a result r: let d(i) = target[i] - nums[i] for 0 <= i < n, and extend it by d(-1) = 0 and d(n) = 0; then r = sum over i = 0..n of max(0, d(i) - d(i-1)).
preconditions: len(nums) = len(target) = n with 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 100000000 and 1 <= target[i] <= 100000000.
